name: Arena
oracle_sentence: Tap target creature you control and target creature of an opponent's choice they control.
cannot_say: AbilityDef::Activated only accepts a single Option<TargetSpec>, and no TargetSpec variant allows an opponent to choose a target or defines multiple distinct targets; furthermore, no Effect variant instructs two target creatures to deal damage equal to their power to each other.
nearest_existing: TargetSpec::Object(&Filter) and TargetReq, which only allow the activating player to select targets from a single filter; and Effect::DealDamage with Amount::TargetPower, which deals damage from the source permanent rather than between two creatures and only evaluates the power of the first target.
